data: From Wilt Chamberlain's 100-point game to the modern era — test your NBA knowledge.
Who holds the NBA record for most points scored in a single game?
Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors against the New York Knicks on March 2, 1962.
How many NBA championships did Michael Jordan win with the Chicago Bulls?
Michael Jordan won 6 NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls in 1991, 1992, 1993, 1996, 1997, and 1998.
Which team has won the most NBA championships in history?
The Boston Celtics have won 17 NBA championships, tied with the Los Angeles Lakers as the most in NBA history.
Who is the NBA's all-time leading scorer?
LeBron James surpassed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar in February 2023 to become the NBA's all-time leading scorer.
Kobe Bryant coined the nickname 'Black Mamba' for himself, inspired by the deadly snake.
In which year was the NBA founded?
The NBA was founded on June 6, 1946, as the Basketball Association of America (BAA), before merging with the NBL in 1949 to form the NBA.
Which team did LeBron James lead to a historic 3-1 Finals comeback in 2016?
LeBron James led the Cleveland Cavaliers to overcome a 3-1 deficit against the Golden State Warriors in the 2016 NBA Finals.
Who was the first player to win back-to-back MVP and Defensive Player of the Year awards in the same season?
Hakeem Olajuwon won both the MVP and Defensive Player of the Year awards in 1993-94, a feat that has never been repeated.
Stephen Curry plays his home games at which arena?
The Golden State Warriors moved to Chase Center in San Francisco in 2019, leaving Oracle Arena in Oakland.
Which player holds the record for most three-pointers made in a single NBA season?
Stephen Curry set the record with 402 three-pointers in the 2015-16 season, breaking his own previous record.
Which team drafted Kobe Bryant with the 13th overall pick in the 1996 NBA Draft?
The Charlotte Hornets drafted Kobe Bryant 13th overall, then traded him to the Los Angeles Lakers for Vlade Divac.
Who won the first ever NBA MVP award in 1956?
Bob Pettit of the St. Louis Hawks won the inaugural NBA MVP award in 1956, the year the award was first given out.
Which coach has the most NBA championship wins as a head coach?
Phil Jackson won 11 NBA championships as a head coach — 6 with the Chicago Bulls and 5 with the Los Angeles Lakers.
What is the diameter of an NBA regulation basketball hoop?
An NBA regulation basketball hoop has an inner diameter of 18 inches (45.72 cm), which is just slightly larger than two basketballs.
Which player scored 81 points in a single NBA game in 2006, the second-highest total ever?
Kobe Bryant scored 81 points for the Los Angeles Lakers against the Toronto Raptors on January 22, 2006, the second-highest single-game total in NBA history.
The 'Dream Team' that won gold at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics was the first US Olympic team to include NBA players. Who coached them?
Chuck Daly, who had previously coached the Detroit Pistons to two championships, coached the legendary 1992 Dream Team to gold in Barcelona.
Which NBA franchise was previously known as the Seattle SuperSonics?
The Oklahoma City Thunder relocated from Seattle in 2008, where they had been the SuperSonics since 1967.
